 Research Experience

  • Post Doctoral Research Fellow, KAUST, Saudi Arabia: RF and Microwave Planar sensor for Biomedical Applications,
     Microwave testing of adhesive lap joints in oil pipelines in collaboration with Saudi ARAMCO.                   (2025-2026)

  • Research Consultant, KAUST, Saudi Arabia: Development of RF and Microwave Planar sensor for Biomedical Applica-
      tions.                                                                                                            (2024)

  • Doctor of Philosophy, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur  : High Sensitivity Planar RF Sensors for Industrial,
     Biomedical and Humanitarian Applications. A number of RF sensors with their full modelling, analysis and fabricated prototype
     with measured results are developed for several real-world applications. To overcome the limitation of resolution, active sensing is
      also explored using passive meta-material inspired sensors for dielectric characterization of plastic samples. A further prototype
     development for wireless sensing systems in the near-field ISM band is also proposed.                            (2018-2024)

  • Research Experience, GE Bangalore, India(GE Research):
     Project 1: Non-Destructive evaluation of Eddy Current sensing system for F-Class Blade Turbine: Modelling and Study of coil
     geometry, crack-recess-sample analyses, voltage variation, field study and experimental exposure.
     Project 2: Motion Observation for cracks in moving blade turbines: experimental validation of cracks in lp/mm to determine

the optimum resolution of cracks in turbine blades
    Project 3: Preliminary/Basics of THz sensing of bio-chemical particles in human breath.                             (2022)

 • Masters Research Experience, Space Applications Center, ISRO, Ahmedabad, India: Design of 102 GHz MMIC
     Multiplier for Sub-MM Wave Receiver Development. Multiplier and Power Amplifier Design in full layout after LVS DRC check,
    modeling verification of MIM capacitors and Spiral inductors from foundry specified models.                        (2017-18)

 • Bachelors Research Experience, Variable Energy Cyclotron Centre, Department of Atomic Energy, India: Design
    Of Cryogenic Temperature Monitor/Controller and Data Acquisition.                                               (2015)

 • Research interest areas: RF sensors, resonators, Electromagnetics, resonant devices, receiver architecture, RFIC, eddy current
     sensing analysis, Active RF Sensors, Material Characterization.

Academic Projects

 • Doctoral Degree Thesis, IIT Kanp: Design Of an FSS Filter with Cylindrical Conductors in Periodic Structure.
    (2019) Main Diagnostics Of Thesis:
      – Design and Simulation Of Cylindrial Conductors (Alumina) in FR4 Substrate in Periodic Structure.
      – Parametric Variation Of Space, Width, Length and Diameter of Conductors to observe change in Filter Character-
            istics.
      – Use Of CST-Microwave Studio for EM Simulation.
      – Design Of Band Stop Filter.
      – Future Proposal- To Device LPF, HPF, BPF using the above technique.

 • Master’s Thesis, The University of Burdwan: Design Of 6GHz Microstrip LPF Using Fractal Bending Technique.
    (2016-18)
   Main Diagnostics Of Thesis :
      – An Effective Technique to Design Compact LPF in the C-Band using ADS.
      – The Size reduction is obtained about One-fifth of the actual conventional filter.
      – There is close agreement between measured and simulated results.

 • Bachelor’s Thesis: Calculation Of Ionization Rate Of Charge Carriers using Multistage Scattering Phenomena.
    (2015)
   Main Diagnostics of Thesis:
      – Use Of an Analytical Model to calculate the Ionization Rate of Charge Carriers like Wz-GaN and 6H-SiC using multistage
          scattering phenomena like Optical Phonon Scattering and Carrier-Carrier Scattering
      – Close Approximation with Kunihiro’s Approximation.
